@graph.headline: 8 Freshdesk Alternatives for 2026
@graph.description: Compare Freshdesk alternatives for ticketing, shared inboxes, CRM support, ecommerce and AI chat, with clear trade-offs and pricing models before switching.

mainEntity.name: What is the best alternative to Freshdesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single best choice. Zoho Desk suits teams that value its free edition and Zoho connections, Help Scout suits shared inbox workflows, Zendesk suits teams that need broader support controls, and Gorgias is worth checking for ecommerce.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free Freshdesk alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zoho Desk has a Free edition for up to three users, Help Scout's Free plan includes five users, one inbox and one Docs site, and HubSpot offers select service tools free. Check each plan's limits before switching.

On annual billing, Freshdesk Growth is US$19 per agent/month and Zendesk Support Team is US$19 per agent/month, checked October 28, 2026. Compare the features in the specific tier; the same starting price does not mean the same scope.

mainEntity.name: Can you export tickets from Freshdesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freshdesk documents filtered ticket-list exports to CSV or Excel, but that export is not the same as a full account export. Use the account export path where available and test a sample before cancelling.

mainEntity.name: Which alternative suits an ecommerce store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gorgias is built around ecommerce support and connects with platforms such as Shopify. Compare its ticket-volume pricing and AI charges with your actual monthly ticket count.

mainEntity.name: What should a team check before leaving Freshdesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Confirm destination import options, export tickets and attachments, map users and custom fields, test a small import, preserve reports and macros where possible, and schedule cutover after owners approve the sample.
